properties.answer: "Go with your recommendation on all points" (Anthony, 2026-07-25). The recommendation had two halves. First: yes, publishing is real intent — being able to show his brother a design without handing over the repo is the strongest single argument on the hosted side. Second, on what "contribute" means: PROPOSE-THEN-ACCEPT, not direct write. A named collaborator can read the design and put intent to it, and the owner accepts it — reach is not authorship, and a design brain whose whole loop is ask-the-human-and-record-the-decision should not let a second person's word enter as the first person's. Also waits on dec:central-host for the mechanism.
properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “Someone without the repo can reach a design, read it, and contribute to it”
properties.question: You said it would be cool to publish reflow2 and storyflow somewhere your brother could reach them and comment on your ideas without cloning your code. Is that a real requirement you want reflow2 to meet — someone you name can open your design, read it, and add intent to it — or is sharing the repo good enough for the two of you? If it is real, does contributing mean writing into your design directly, or proposing something you then accept?
